text:
Ibrahim: quick sync - post-launch micro-decision. do we pack the small perf slice and the customer UX tweak into Saturday hotpatch or defer one to the mini-wave?
Claire: customer UX tweak = sticky toolbar reposition, reported by 2 customers (low severity). Perf slice = GPU batching tweak that reduces tail p95 by ~8% for long-context requests.
Max: QE window for hotpatch is 36hrs. perf change touches scheduler layer, needs perf regression runs. UX tweak is tiny but needs visual QA.
Elena: my vote: include perf tweak in hotpatch because it directly helps SLOs for customers on large prompts. ship toolbar tweak behind flag in the hotpatch if feasible.
Ibrahim: tradeoff: perf has slight rollout risk. do we have a rollback path?
Max: yes - we can gate the scheduler change by release toggle and rollback by flipping routing to previous scheduler binary. I can own the rollback script.
Claire: gating sounds good. for UX flag, we can default off and enable for internal only in canary. avoids extra QA scope.
release-bot: scheduled canary: v1.3.2-hotfix -> Sat 02:00 UTC to group "canary-internal". checks: smoke, perf-regressions, visual QA.
Elena: propose decision: include perf batching (flagged) in hotpatch + toolbar behind internal flag. owners: Max -> perf PR + rollback script, Claire -> toolbar flag PR & visual QA checklist, Ibrahim -> release notes & CS blurb, Elena -> pre-canary signoff.
Max: timeline: can land flagged perf branch by Fri EOD; need 1hr pairing with Claire for visual checks.
Claire: I can pair Fri 10:00 UTC. QE plan: 6 smoke cases + perf run focused on p95/p99. rollback triggers: p99 latency regress > 10% or error-rate > 0.25% over baseline.
Ibrahim: noted. customer comms: will mention targeted perf improvement and that toolbar will be internal-only until validated. send draft to #customer-success by Fri 15:00 UTC.
Elena: ops: confirm monitoring hooks for scheduling metric and ability to switch to old scheduler within 5 minutes.
Max: will add monitoring + automated alert if p99 increases beyond threshold.
release-bot: reminder: pre-canary sync Sat 01:15 UTC.
Ibrahim: summary: perf batching + toolbar behind flag in hotpatch. owners assigned, canary scheduled. If blockers appear overnight ping me.
Claire: ack.
Max: ack.
Elena: ack.
